caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of patterned wallpaper with a beige background bordered on the left by a vertical green strip featuring an intricate geometric design. Centrally positioned are two repeating vignettes arranged vertically: the upper vignette shows a reclining human figure in grayish-white hues, set amidst gray rocks and green foliage; the lower vignette displays an urn or vase, also in grayish-white, placed on a rocky surface with surrounding green plants. Both vignettes are accentuated by stylized white floral motifs with green centers on their top and bottom edges. Subtle vertical decorative lines run parallel to the side borders near the edges of the beige area. A scale is printed at the bottom left corner in black, marked from 0 to 2. The drawing is presented on a larger cream-colored sheet, leaving a wide margin around the wallpaper design.
title: Wall Paper
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
